title: Kevvu Keka
desc: Lakshmi's father does not approve of her relationship with her boyfriend, Buchi, as he is not rich. She then challenges him that Buchi will become a millionaire in six months.

title: Sakthi
desc: An ordinary tour guide comes to the rescue of a prominent politician's daughter after some evil Egyptians try to hunt her down in order to steal a sacred diamond.

title: Su From So
desc: In the coastal village of Marlur, Ashoka's innocent crush sparks rumours of ghostly possession, creating comedic chaos and unexpected twists.

title: Bujjigaadu: Made in Chennai
desc: Bujji moves to Chennai for 12 years to stay away from his best friend Chitti, with the promise that she will marry him. When they finally reunite, Bujji is a thug with a mission on his hands.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Radha Gopalam
desc: Gopalam, an assistant public prosecutor, marries Radha, a judge's daughter. However, when Radha becomes a lawyer and proves to be more talented than him, his ego threatens to ruin their relationship.

title: Okkade
desc: A minister assigns Yugandhar, an honest police officer, to find a way to stop gang leader Subbarayudu and his followers who are running a parallel government.

title: Gautamiputra Satakarni
desc: Gautamiputra Satakarni, who is the emperor of the kingdom of Satavahana, faces several threats and tries to overcome them during his attempts to unite all the kingdoms.

title: Darling
desc: Prabha prepares to meet Nandini, his childhood friend, at a reunion party organised by his father. However, things take a turn when Nisha, a gangster's daughter, falls in love with him.

title: Raja Rani
desc: Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Baak
desc: Shiva's search for the truth behind his estranged sister's death leads him to her mansion, where a mysterious supernatural presence lurks. Can he stop it before it consumes him?

title: Sarvam Maya
desc: After crossing paths with a ghost, a Hindu priest embarks on an enlightening journey that causes him to question his faith, his identity and everything he believed to be true.
